answer: Use a progressive fee curve against sybils. The first identity is nearly free, light as a zephyr, but each extra identity funded from the same source costs exponentially more, so one honest agent pays almost nothing while a thousand fakes become unaffordable. Fees are burned, not paid to any operator, removing the profit motive. A pearl-grade credential is granted only after verified useful work, and a plume-light public audit trail links each credential to its fee payment, so duplicate identities stand out without exposing private keys.
